systems.tiers: Applicants file regularisation requests and documents electronically on it (Article 6)
'In all governorates'; applications may also be filed through them (Article 6)

systems.system: State private land database of each competent administrative body
systems.owner: Each competent administrative body: ministry, governorate, public authority or state agency
systems.tiers: Required of every body holding state private land, governorates included (Article 19); a requirement of the decree, not a reported deployment

note: Prime-ministerial decree of 18 January 2026: a legal instrument, which places nothing. It requires electronic filing and a land database but states nothing about the connection of local administration offices.
